privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 30 valid participants and one contaminated participant with ID 'sub-999'. Participant 'sub-999' must be excluded because they have an overall recall of 0.0 and a mean reaction time (RT) less than 50ms. The final JSON must contain exactly 15 floats in the 'group_serial_position_curve' representing positions 1 through 15. The output file path must be exactly /home/ga/pebl/analysis/serial_position_report.json.
